motifs.description: The evaluated side has a moderate move-order-adjusted surplus of two to five surviving stones.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'moderate net capture surplus'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The evaluated side has a moderate move-order-adjusted surplus of two to five surviving stones.'
def motif(board_rows: list[str], color: str) -> bool:
    opp = 'W' if color == 'B' else 'B'
    balance = sum(row.count(color) - row.count(opp) for row in board_rows)
    balance += color == 'W'
    return 2 <= balance <= 5

MOTIF_NAME = 'reinforced uncontested liberty reserve'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The evaluated side has a substantial surplus of locally uncontested liberties, especially where multiple stones support the same point.'
def motif(board_rows: list[str], color: str) -> bool:
    opp = 'W' if color == 'B' else 'B'
    pad = '!' * 21
    board = pad + ''.join('!' + row + '!' for row in board_rows) + pad
    score = 4 if color == 'W' else -4

    for r in range(19):
        base = (r + 1) * 21 + 1
        for c in range(19):
            i = base + c
            if board[i] != '.':
                continue
            own = ((board[i - 21] == color) + (board[i + 21] == color) +
                   (board[i - 1] == color) + (board[i + 1] == color))
            enemy = ((board[i - 21] == opp) + (board[i + 21] == opp) +
                     (board[i - 1] == opp) + (board[i + 1] == opp))
            if own and not enemy:
                score += own + (own > 1)
            elif enemy and not own:
                score -= enemy + (enemy > 1)

    return score >= 6

MOTIF_NAME = 'clean bamboo joint surplus'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The evaluated side has more intact bamboo-joint formations with both connecting points empty than the opponent.'
def motif(board_rows: list[str], color: str) -> bool:
    opp = 'W' if color == 'B' else 'B'
    count = {'B': 0, 'W': 0}
    for r in range(18):
        for c in range(17):
            stone = board_rows[r][c]
            if (stone in count and board_rows[r][c + 2] == stone
                    and board_rows[r + 1][c] == stone
                    and board_rows[r + 1][c + 2] == stone
                    and board_rows[r][c + 1] == board_rows[r + 1][c + 1] == '.'):
                count[stone] += 1
    for r in range(17):
        for c in range(18):
            stone = board_rows[r][c]
            if (stone in count and board_rows[r][c + 1] == stone
                    and board_rows[r + 2][c] == stone
                    and board_rows[r + 2][c + 1] == stone
                    and board_rows[r + 1][c] == board_rows[r + 1][c + 1] == '.'):
                count[stone] += 1
    return count[color] > count[opp]
